content.title: Single-Accent Scale Activation | One Signal Relays into an Environmental Network
content.summary: Reserve a near-monochrome world, establish at least three measurable scales, and introduce exactly one saturated accent at a local source. Preserve the same hue through a visible carrier as its functional reach expands into a stable environment-wide network without any competing saturated color.

quick_start.input_format: near-monochrome low-saturation world + at least three comparable scales + exactly one saturated activation hue and local source + same hue relayed through a visible carrier + earlier anchors preserved + stable largest-scale network mapping
quick_start.recommended_input: In a mineral blue-grey desalination plant, an adult technician inserts one amber diagnostic puck into a dark spiral-valve port. The same amber pulse travels through visible pipe seams, reaches successively larger junctions and finally maps the reservoir-routing network while no other saturated color appears.
required_anchors: Reserve the world to one narrow low-saturation color family before any activation.
Establish at least three measurable scales with persistent comparison anchors.
Relay the same hue through a visible physical or informational carrier while earlier anchors remain recognizable.
Resolve the accent as a stable environment-scale network or system state with no new competing color.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Reserve a near-monochrome world, establish at least three measurable scales, and introduce exactly one saturated accent at a local source. Preserve the same hue through a visible carrier as its functional reach expands into a stable environment-wide network without any competing saturated color.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build a world from one narrow low-saturation color family and establish at least three readable scales before activation. Introduce exactly one high-saturation accent hue at a small local source, then preserve hue identity while moving the signal through a visible carrier to a larger structure and finally to an environment-wide network. Each scale transition must retain prior monochrome anchors and expand the accent's functional reach without allowing other saturated colors to appear. End on a stable system state where the same accent maps connectivity or activation across the largest scale. The reusable mechanism is chromatic reservation, measurable scale ladder, single-source activation, visible carrier relay and network payoff—not the source frozen city, snow, giant humanoid, stone hand, tiny person, hood, golden eyes, molten roads, architecture, exact timing, creator identity or unsupported model mapping.

invariants.purpose: Makes the signal's expansion legible across size changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abstract close-ups alone hide scale progression.

invariants.rule: Introduce exactly one saturated accent hue from one local source.
invariants.purpose: Assigns clear causal and visual priority.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several activation hues divide attention and causality.

invariants.rule: Relay the same hue through a visible physical or informational carrier while earlier anchors remain recognizable.
invariants.purpose: Connects local activation to larger consequences.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated color appearing elsewhere breaks continuity.

invariants.rule: Resolve the accent as a stable environment-scale network or system state with no new competing color.
invariants.ablation_failure: A final flash without mapped reach does not prove propagation.
